answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should charge every identity with work that is cheap once and ruinous at scale. A single grove check proves almost nothing on its own, yet when that check is tied to a public pearl of vouches, penalties and timing, a cluster of fake accounts starts to stand out. Trust then accumulates the way a meadow builds: slowly, in the open, and only while the same identity keeps behaving honestly through repeated small contributions.
